title: Give a medical instruction
summary: From the record: Create → Medical instruction. Text from a template with the patient's details, to print.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Medical instruction
steps.details: Opens Instructions and the new instruction form.

steps.title: Tooth
steps.details: Optional: the tooth it refers to.

steps.title: Template
steps.details: Loads the text with the patient's variables already filled in.

steps.title: Content
steps.details: Edit it freely. «Update variables» reloads the patient's details.
